It's been a wild week in AI, and on episode 126 of Mixture of Experts, host Tim Hwang and co-host David Zax talk to panelists Kaoutar El Maghraoui, Gabe Goodhart and Martin Keen to  discuss what all these releases have in common: efficiency. 

We start with the model release pile-up. Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5, and OpenAI launched GPT-6 Sol and Luna. Opus 5.5 is 20% cheaper than earlier Opus models, while GPT-6 Luna costs half what its predecessor did, at just 10 cents per million input tokens. We look at what a real price war means for developers building on these models and the companies racing to lower costs.
